paper_title: I Don't Know Explicit Modeling of Uncertainty with an [IDK] Token
caption: : Tradeoff between and for different parameter combinations. We annotate each data point with its corresponding value.

annotations.annotation: The line plot illustrates the relationship between IDK error rate and IDK recall under different conditions, denoted by variations of a specific regulation parameter, LFP-reg, and lambda configuration. The x-axis, labeled "IDK error rate," is linear, ranging from 0.0 to 0.25 with tick labels at intervals of 0.05. The y-axis, labeled "IDK recall," is also linear, ranging from 0.1 to 0.6 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. There are four lines represented in the plot. The first line is blue with crosses as markers and a solid style, beginning at approximately (0.02, 0.1) and ending at (0.25, 0.5), showing a steady increase. The second line, orange with circle markers and a solid style, starts at around (0.02, 0.1) and ends at (0.17, 0.5), also displaying a steady upward trend. The third line is green with triangle markers and a dashed style, starting at about (0.05, 0.2) and showing an increase to (0.2, 0.5). Lastly, the fourth line is red with triangle markers and a dashed style, beginning at (0.03, 0.2) and rising steeply to (0.1, 0.5). A legend is placed at the top center of the plot.
